ablations: Full context without cache versus full context with cache: prefix-cache-v1.
Uncached full context versus uncached dependency slice: dependency-slice-v1.
Both arms cached: slice-versus-full-cache-v1, the primary strong comparator.
baseline: Complete original record table with same-slot prefix caching enabled; candidate uses dependency slice with caching also enabled. Each arm has its own real cold-start history.
claim_limit: Instrumented CPU cache-compression interaction and model-transfer study; substantial known prior-art overlap; novelty unestablished; this eight-request development case cannot establish measurement eligibility, broad natural-language quality, energy savings, API-price equivalence or novelty.
confirmation_isolation: Separate modules, candidate receives prompt only, regenerated fixed answers, distinct seeded split, frozen implementation hashes. Shared Unix identity: workflow convention, not an adversarial security boundary.
development_evidence: Root reports0.5B reference-chain/context8 only1/8correctperarm; quality investigator reportslookup/context8 6/8perarm. These are warning signals, not outcomes of the newly frozen repeated-table population.
hypothesis: Repeated-table full-context caching can reuse the original table prefix across changing queries, while query-dependent dependency slices can destroy that reuse. Shorter prompts may then have no quality-qualified full-cost advantage; actual native histories, not API prices or two hypothetical simultaneous caches, decide.
question: When do context omission savings disappear against full-context prefix caching under repeated tables, longer contexts, arrivals and model transfer?
selection_rule: Require each full-context baseline attempt at least95% exact task accuracy (8/8 in eight-request feasibility). If baseline fails, preserve complete adverse study and do not launch small-model confirmations. Any harmful omission remains visible.
stopping_rule: Exactly frozen cells once. No automatic rerun, no filtering baseline failures, no gate relaxation. Stop before request/time/globaldeadline caps. Failed/interrupted native attempts retain costs and cancel remaining confirmation cells.
uncertainty: Two balanced AB/BA pairs; descriptive pair ranges only. Eight-query shared-table trajectories are dependent. No request-IID confidence or cross-device/population claim.
